content.short: Stargazer provides a graph engine for blockchain-native AI.
content.description: Stargazer, built on the Unified Knowledge Graph, enables AI agents to interpret on-chain data and interact with crypto applications. It supports AI transformation for crypto companies through Multi-Service AI Agents with deep on-chain knowledge and makes apps accessible to autonomous agents, helping developers participate in the AI-to-AI economy and to leverage AI-driven interactions with blockchain services.
content.meta: Stargazer leverages a Unified Knowledge Graph to help AI agents interpret on-chain data. Discover Stargazer and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
